description: Reassignment local search only: For each broken adjacent edge, form one repair that releases its lower-reward endpoint and another that releases its higher-reward endpoint; ties choose the previous and next endpoints respectively. Reconsider incoming unscheduled tasks followed by the released tasks. Compare the feasible issued trials and return the higher-profit one, or null if there are no broken edges or no feasible trial. It does not implement initialization.
Purpose: Try two endpoint-release rules for broken edges without automatically rebuilding the entire satellite.
